Container.Name: talos-companion
Container.Overview: Self-hosted identity and encrypted recovery for Talos Omni. Includes a browser wizard for Cloudflare and Tailscale authorization. Provider clients use the existing appdata mount; no additional container or Docker options are needed.

Config.Name: Omni managed configuration
Config.Description: Optional dedicated overlay directory prepared by the home installer. Never mount Omni keys or its database here.

Config.Name: Network backup share
Config.Description: Existing NFS or SMB mount managed by Unraid

Config.Name: Setup token override
Config.Description: Optional 24+ characters. Blank generates a private token shown in first-start container logs.

Config.Name: Backup passphrase override
Config.Description: Optional 16+ characters. Blank generates a persistent private passphrase; save it from the setup wizard.

Config.Name: Mounted destination
Config.Description: Use only with a real host mount
